title: Hacker Villager
description: Place a command block next to an unemployed villager and the villager will now offer you unobtainable items!
body:
# Hacker Villager
## Description
This is a mod that adds a new custom villager proffesion and new custom trades centered around items and blocks that are unobtainable in survival mode.
## How to Use
To make the hacker villager, you must place a command block next to an unemployed villager so that the villager uses the command block as its job block. Once the villager accepts the command block as its job block, its texture will change you can now trade with it for unobtainable items.
## All Trades
Below are all the trades the hacker villager can offer.

### NOVICE
Tipped arrow with no effect — 1 emerald

Potion with no effect — 1 emerald

Splash potion with no effect — 2 emeralds

Lingering potion with no effect — 3 emeralds

Structure void — 3 emeralds

Farmland — 4 emeralds

Steve head — 5 emeralds

Enchanted book with no enchantments — 5 emeralds


### APPRENTICE
Light block — 6 emeralds

Suspicious sand — 8 emeralds

Suspicious gravel — 8 emeralds

Jigsaw — 10 emeralds

Structure block — 15 emeralds

Debug stick — 20 emeralds

Frogspawn — 20 emeralds


### JOURNEYMAN
Spawner — 1 emerald block

Trial spawner — 5 emerald blocks

Trial vault — 6 emerald blocks

Infested cobble — 4 emerald blocks

Knowledge book — 5 emerald blocks

Dragon egg — 8 emerald blocks

Villager spawn egg — 10 emerald blocks

Warden spawn egg — 28 emerald blocks

Dragon spawn egg — 45 emerald blocks


### EXPERT
Reinforced deepslate — 20 emerald blocks

End portal frame — 32 emerald blocks

Test block — 36 emerald blocks

Test instance block — 40 emerald blocks

### MASTER
Command Block — 56 emerald blocks

Repeating Command Block — 56 emerald blocks

Chain Command Block — 56 emerald blocks

Command Block in minecart — 56 emerald blocks

Barrier - 50 emerald blocks

Bedrock - 60 emerald blocks
